metadata.purpose: Reference geometry labels and preferred geometries used by FRUTON metalls_check.py for first-pass transition-metal coordination classification.
metadata.scope: This file is a conservative decision table, not a replacement for bonded metal parameterization. It is meant to flag transition-metal sites for Gaussian/RESP/CESGA parameter work and to color workbook geometry fields.

references.title: Geometry of metal-ligand interactions in proteins
references.note: Protein metal-site geometry and coordination-number reference; covers Ca, Mg, Mn, Fe, Cu, Zn and donor distances/geometries.

references.title: Transition metal binding selectivity in proteins and its correlation with the phylogenomic classification of the cation diffusion facilitator protein family
references.note: Useful biological context for common transition-metal donor preferences and octahedral geometries in proteins.

references.title: MESPEUS: a database of metal coordination groups in proteins
references.note: Database reference for curated metalloprotein coordination groups and geometry descriptors across 40 metal types.

references.title: MetalHawk: Enhanced Classification of Metal Coordination Sites in Proteins
references.note: Modern metal coordination-number and geometry classification reference.
